# VC10X

> VC10X is a podcast and newsletter hosted by Prashant Choubey, with 300+ conversations with asset managers, allocators and family office principals on how capital is actually raised, allocated and protected. The site also offers free tools for venture fund managers, allocators and families.

All tools are free. Audit answers and calculator inputs stay in the visitor's browser.

## Tools

- [Venture Fund Economics Calculator](https://vc10x.com/fund-economics-calculator/): Model management fees by year, GP commit (cash or fee waiver), and the return a fund must deliver before carried interest pays out, with carry at different outcomes.
- [Private Markets Commitment Pacing Model](https://vc10x.com/commitment-pacing-model/): For CIOs and allocators. Solves for the annual commitment needed to reach a target private markets allocation, with projected capital calls, distributions and NAV (Takahashi-Alexander style model).
- [Liquidity Stress Test](https://vc10x.com/liquidity-stress-test/): For CIOs and allocators. Tests whether a portfolio can meet capital calls and spending after a market shock, how far the private allocation drifts (the denominator effect), and whether equities would have to be sold.
- [Fund Performance Calculator](https://vc10x.com/fund-performance-calculator/): Calculates TVPI, DPI, RVPI, net IRR and a Kaplan-Schoar public market equivalent (PME) from a fund's annual cash flows and NAV.
- [The LP Fit Audit](https://vc10x.com/lp-fit-audit/): Fourteen questions that rank eight LP types (angels, family offices, funds of funds, endowments, pensions and sovereigns, corporates, wealth platforms, DFIs) by fit for a venture fund.
- [The Fundraising Readiness Audit](https://vc10x.com/fundraising-audit/): Twenty questions that score a venture fund manager's readiness to raise across track record, LP pipeline, materials, terms and process.
- [The Family Gap Audit](https://vc10x.com/audit/): Twenty questions that score a family or family office on succession, governance, next-gen readiness, investment architecture, and privacy and security.
- [The Family Office Readiness Audit](https://vc10x.com/family-office-readiness/): Twelve questions that rank a wealth manager, multi-family office, outsourced family office and single-family office by fit for a family, with an estimated annual cost for each.
- [The Liquidity Event Readiness Audit](https://vc10x.com/liquidity-event-audit/): Twenty questions for founders and family business owners selling a company, covering pre-sale tax and estate planning, advisors, a deployment plan, family, and privacy.
- [Advisor Fee Calculator](https://vc10x.com/advisor-fee-calculator/): Shows the dollars paid to a wealth manager over time, the growth given up, and what a lower or flat fee would change.
